description: A mock implementation of an ApiService for a fashion retail platform, simulating network operations such as fetching products, user login, registration, and checkout, primarily used for testing or development without real backend integration.

classes.name: MockApiService
classes.description: A mock implementation of ApiService that simulates network calls with artificial delays for testing purposes.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login and returns a UserSession.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration and returns a UserSession.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Simulates the checkout process, returning an OrderSummary.
